column1: # M5 video fixtures — one file per container, each carrying 9.0 s of real speech
# (the TTS sample build/share/suramak-sample-en.mp3, 16 kHz mono) plus a testsrc
# video stream, so container+video coexistence is real. Commands are runnable
# from the repo root with ffmpeg n9.0.1; regeneration matches in content, not
# bytes (mp4/mov embed creation timestamps, matroska a random SegmentUID).
# M10C adds two rows: the raw Ogg-Opus fixture (the webm's Opus stream copied out
# of its container — the WhatsApp/Discord voice-note shape) and the ALAC m4a that
# keeps the unsupported-codec error path pinned (built with ffmpeg 8.0.1 on the
# dev VPS; the opus rows above decode natively since M10C).
# Source speech: "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Suramak keeps
# every recording on this machine and never sends audio to the cloud."
# file
sample-en.mp4
column4: ffmpeg -y -f lavfi -i testsrc=size=160x120:rate=5 -i build/share/suramak-sample-en.mp3 -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v libx264 -preset veryslow -crf 51 -c:a aac -b:a 64k -movflags +faststart -shortest -f mp4 fixtures/video/sample-en.mp4
